claims.quote: Ancistrus formoso Sabino & Trajano, 1997. Common name: Blind Cave Bristlenose. Maximum size 79 mm (3.1") SL. Type locality: Buraco do Ducho cave, Serra da Bodoquena, Município de Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. IUCN Red List: Vulnerable (last assessed 2018).
South America: La Plata, Paraná, Paraguay, Upper Paraguay and Formoso drainage basins, Brazil.
